items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: Thundercat was there too so some of the songs he wrote he came in and showed me the joint, I learned it and then he would record and I would just like play what I heard

ctx.x: No charts. No I just played it and I listened to it. Thundercat was there too so some of the songs he wrote he came in and showed me the joint, I learned it and then he would record and I would just like play what I heard, you know? And so there was nine songs on the album. So I came back Grammy week, because we were nominated for Black Radio 2 at that time. And so I came back Grammy week and that’s when we did the “Mortal Man” the very last song with the Tupac interview on it. That’s when I recorded that. But…
